items.source: since 7.0 in favor of configuring converters on configureMessageConverters(HttpMessageConverters.ServerBuilder)
items.translation: 自 7.0 版本起，建议使用在configureMessageConverters(HttpMessageConverters.ServerBuilder)上配置转换器。

items.source: Add to the list of ErrorResponse.Interceptor's to apply when rendering an RFC 9457 ProblemDetail error response.
items.translation: 添加到渲染 RFC 9457 ProblemDetail错误响应时应用的ErrorResponse.Interceptor列表中。

items.source: Add Converters and Formatters in addition to the ones registered by default.
items.translation: 添加 `Converters` 和 `Formatters`，除了默认注册的那些之外。

items.source: Help with configuring HandlerMapping path matching options such as whether to use parsed PathPatterns or String pattern matching with PathMatcher, whether to match trailing slashes, and more.
items.translation: 帮助配置HandlerMapping路径匹配选项，例如是否使用解析后的PathPatterns或带有PathMatcher的字符串模式匹配，是否匹配尾随斜杠等。

items.source: Configure the HttpMessageConverters instance being built.
items.translation: 配置正在构建的HttpMessageConverters实例。

items.source: Configure view resolvers to translate String-based view names returned from controllers into concrete View implementations to perform rendering with.
items.translation: 配置视图解析器，将控制器返回的基于字符串的视图名称转换为具体的View实现，以用于执行渲染。

items.source: resolvers - initially an empty list
items.translation: resolvers - 初始为空列表

items.source: Note that use of this method turns off default converter registration. However, in a Spring Boot application the WebMvcAutoConfiguration adds any HttpMessageConverter beans as well as default converters. Hence, in a Boot application use HttpMessageConverters. Alternatively, for any scenario, use extendMessageConverters(java.util.List) to modify the configured list of message converters.
items.translation: 注意，使用此方法会关闭默认转换器注册。然而，在 Spring Boot 应用中，`WebMvcAutoConfiguration` 也会添加任何 `HttpMessageConverter` Bean 以及默认转换器。因此，在 Boot 应用中请使用HttpMessageConverters。或者，对于任何场景，均可使用extendMessageConverters(java.util.List)来修改已配置的消息转换器列表。

items.source: Annotated controllers can further declare more fine-grained config via @CrossOrigin. In such cases "global" CORS configuration declared here is combined with local CORS configuration defined on a controller method.
items.translation: 注释控制器可以通过 @CrossOrigin 声明更细粒度的配置。在这种情况下，此处声明的“全局”CORS 配置将与在控制器方法上定义的本地 CORS 配置进行 合并。

items.source: This does not override the built-in support for resolving handler method arguments. To customize the built-in support for argument resolution, configure RequestMappingHandlerAdapter directly.
items.translation: 这不会覆盖用于解析处理器方法参数的内置支持。若要自定义参数解析的内置支持，请直接配置 RequestMappingHandlerAdapter。

items.source: Note that the order of converter registration is important. Especially in cases where clients accept MediaType.ALL the converters configured earlier will be preferred.
items.translation: 请注意，转换器注册的顺序非常重要。特别是在客户端接受 `MediaType.ALL` 的情况下，先前配置的转换器将被优先使用。

items.source: The given list starts out empty. If it is left empty, the framework configures a default set of resolvers, see WebMvcConfigurationSupport.addDefaultHandlerExceptionResolvers(List, org.springframework.web.accept.ContentNegotiationManager). Or if any exception resolvers are added to the list, then the application effectively takes over and must provide, fully initialized, exception resolvers.
items.translation: 给定的列表初始为空。如果将其留空，框架将配置一组默认的解析器，请参阅 WebMvcConfigurationSupport.addDefaultHandlerExceptionResolvers(List, org.springframework.web.accept.ContentNegotiationManager)。 或者，如果向该列表添加了任何异常解析器，则应用程序将接管并必须提供完全初始化好的异常解析器。

items.source: Alternatively you can use extendHandlerExceptionResolvers(List) which allows you to extend or modify the list of exception resolvers configured by default.
items.translation: 或者，您可以使用 extendHandlerExceptionResolvers(List) 来扩展或修改默认配置的异常解析器列表。

items.source: @EnableWebMvc-annotated configuration classes may implement this interface to be called back and given a chance to customize the default configuration.
items.translation: 带有 `@EnableWebMvc` 注解的配置类可以实现此接口，以便被回调并有机会自定义默认配置。

items.source:
Using this option does not override the built-in support for handling
return values. To customize the built-in support for handling return
values, configure RequestMappingHandlerAdapter directly.
items.translation: 使用此选项不会覆盖内置的返回值处理支持。若要自定义内置的返回值处理支持，请直接配置 `RequestMappingHandlerAdapter`。

items.source:
By default, all built-in converters are configured as long as the
corresponding 3rd party libraries such Jackson JSON, JAXB2, and others
are present on the classpath.
items.translation: 默认情况下，只要类路径中存在相应的第三方库（如 Jackson JSON、JAXB2 等），所有内置转换器都会进行配置。

items.source: Provide a custom Validator instead of the one created by default. The default implementation, assuming JSR-303 is on the classpath, is: OptionalValidatorFactoryBean. Leave the return value as null to keep the default.
items.translation: 提供自定义的Validator，而不是使用默认创建的实例。 默认实现（假设 JSR-303 在类路径中）是： OptionalValidatorFactoryBean。 将返回值保留为null以保持默认设置。

items.source: Provide a custom MessageCodesResolver for building message codes from data binding and validation error codes. Leave the return value as null to keep the default.
items.translation: 提供自定义的 MessageCodesResolver 以从数据绑定和验证错误代码构建消息代码。将返回值保留为null以保持默认行为。

items.source: Provide a custom MessageCodesResolver for building message codes from data binding and validation error codes.
items.translation: 提供自定义的MessageCodesResolver，用于从数据绑定和验证错误代码构建消息代码。

items.source: Configure a handler to delegate unhandled requests by forwarding to the Servlet container's "default" servlet. A common use case for this is when the DispatcherServlet is mapped to "/" thus overriding the Servlet container's default handling of static resources.
items.translation: 配置一个处理器，将未处理的手请求委托给 Servlet 容器的"default"servlet。此配置的常见用例是当 DispatcherServlet 映射到 "/" 时，从而覆盖了 Servlet 容器对静态资源的默认处理。

items.source:
Add handlers to serve static resources such as images, js, and, css
files from specific locations under web application root, the classpath,
and others.
items.translation: 添加处理器，用于从 Web 应用程序根目录下的特定位置、类路径以及其他位置提供静态资源（如图像、js 和 css 文件）。

items.source: Configure asynchronous request handling options.
items.translation: 配置异步请求处理选项。

items.source: Configure content negotiation options.
items.translation: 配置内容协商选项。

items.source:
Add Spring MVC lifecycle interceptors for pre- and post-processing of
controller method invocations and resource handler requests.
Interceptors can be registered to apply to all requests or be limited
to a subset of URL patterns.
items.translation: 为控制器方法调用和资源处理器请求添加用于预处理和后处理的 Spring MVC 生命周期拦截器。可以注册拦截器以应用于所有请求，或将其限制为特定 URL 模式的子集。

items.source:
Configure simple automated controllers pre-configured with the response
status code and/or a view to render the response body. This is useful in
cases where there is no need for custom controller logic -- for example, render a
home page, perform simple site URL redirects, return a 404 status with
HTML content, a 204 with no content, and more.
items.translation: 配置简单的自动化控制器，并预置用于渲染响应体的状态码和/或视图。在无需自定义控制器逻辑的情况下非常有用——例如，渲染主页、执行简单的站点 URL 重定向、返回带有 HTML 内容的 404 状态、返回无内容的 204 状态等。

items.source:
Extending or modify the list of exception resolvers configured by default.
This can be useful for inserting a custom exception resolver without
interfering with default ones.
items.translation: 扩展或修改默认配置的异常解析器列表。这对于在不干扰默认解析器的情况下插入自定义异常解析器非常有用。

items.source: handlers - initially an empty list
items.translation: handlers - 初始为一个空列表

items.source: builder - the builder to configure
items.translation: builder - 要配置的构建器

items.source: converters - initially an empty list of converters
items.translation: converters - 初始为空转换器列表

items.source: converters - the list of configured converters to be extended
items.translation: converters - 要扩展的已配置转换器列表

items.source: resolvers - the list of configured resolvers to extend
items.translation: resolvers - 用于扩展的已配置解析器列表

items.source: interceptors - the interceptors to use
items.translation: interceptors - 要使用的拦截器

items.source: Rossen Stoyanchev, Keith Donald, David Syer
items.translation: Rossen Stoyanchev，Keith Donald，David Syer

items.translation: 提供自定义的Validator，而不是使用默认创建的实例。

items.source: Add resolvers to support custom controller method argument types.
items.translation: 添加解析器以支持自定义控制器方法参数类型。

items.source: Configure "global" cross-origin request processing.
items.translation: 配置“全局”跨域请求处理。

items.source:
Add Spring MVC lifecycle interceptors for pre- and post-processing of
controller method invocations and resource handler requests.
items.translation: 为控制器方法调用和资源处理器请求添加用于预处理和后处理的 Spring MVC 生命周期拦截器。

items.source: Add handlers to support custom controller method return value types.
items.translation: 添加处理器以支持自定义控制器方法返回值类型。

items.source:
Configure simple automated controllers pre-configured with the response
status code and/or a view to render the response body.
items.translation: 配置简单的自动化控制器，这些控制器已预配置了响应状态代码和/或用于渲染响应体的视图。

items.source: Configure API versioning for the application.
items.translation: 配置应用程序的 API 版本控制。

items.source:
Configure a handler to delegate unhandled requests by forwarding to the
Servlet container's "default" servlet.
items.translation: 配置一个处理器，将未处理的手请求委托给 Servlet 容器的"default"servlet。

items.source: Configure exception resolvers.
items.translation: 配置异常解析器。

items.source: Extending or modify the list of exception resolvers configured by default.
items.translation: 扩展或修改默认配置的异常解析器列表。

items.source:
Configure API versioning for the application. In order for versioning to
be enabled, you must configure at least one way to resolve the API
version from a request (e.g. via request header).
items.translation: 配置应用程序的 API 版本控制。若要启用版本控制，您必须至少配置一种从请求中解析 API 版本的方法（例如通过请求头）。
